newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans march against far right after punk killed.
newsitem.headline: Germans march against far right after punk killed.

text.p: Around 1,000 people gathered for a protest march against right-wing extremism in the east German city of Magdeburg on Saturday.

It was organised in response to the killing of a 17-year old punk rocker who was beaten and stabbed to death earlier this month. A member of the city's extreme right wing scene has been arrested on suspicion of carrying out the attack.
Punks angry at the death of their friend clashed with police during a demonstration last week.
Police said there had been no major incidents at Saturday's rally. They had searched almost 300 people on their way to the protest and turned 19 away, a spokesman said.
